title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Terms of Enrollment: Plan Changes
content:
**Terms.** Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program plan changes are made only on an enrollment in status active, as the program's enrollment record shows. A plan change request received on or before the cutoff day of a month takes effect on the first day of the next month. A request received after that day takes effect on the first day of the month after next. The new plan must be offered at the enrollment's campus and must admit the student's grade.

**Semester limit.** At most the semester allowance of plan changes take effect per enrollment per semester; a further request waits for the next semester. The semester is fall (August 1 through December 31) or spring (January 1 through June 30), whichever contains the month the requested change would take effect. Changes are counted by the plan change fees on the enrollment whose billing month falls in that semester.

**Fee.** Each plan change posts one plan change fee for the billing month in which it takes effect. A month already posted under the old plan is not rebilled.

## Figures by plan

| Figure (same on all six Creek Kids Club plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| Request cutoff day | day 20 of the month |
| Plan change fee | 10.00 per approved change |
| Plan changes per enrollment per semester | 2 |

## Effective dates (hypothetical requests)

| Request received | Takes effect |
|---|---|
| the 20th of a month | the 1st of the next month |
| the 21st of a month | the 1st of the month after next |
| the 3rd of a month | the 1st of the next month |

## Semester allowance (hypothetical)

Two plan changes have already taken effect in September and November. A third request that would take effect in December falls in the same fall semester, so it waits for the spring semester. A request that would first take effect in January counts toward spring.
